doc.title: Arturo Sandoval interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 12, 2023

title: Closing: driving Dizzy in Cuba and thanks
summary: Rowe recalls Sandoval driving Dizzy around Cuba in 1977 in a 1951 Plymouth and his becoming a citizen body and soul; they trade thanks.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Thank you. Well I’ll wrap up with two observations. One is that you’ve come a really long way since you drove Dizzy around in Cuba in 1977 in your little broken down car.

1951. And secondly I saw an interview, the fellow asked you why did you pursue becoming a citizen here and you succinctly said that you moved here body and soul. And I thought that was about the best way you could have put it, and I want to thank you for your time and sharing your innermost stories today.
Thank you so much, sir. It’s been my pleasure and you know all your questions and your personality and everything, you know, made me feel extremely comfortable and good. Thank you so much.
